info.title: LankaLens FastAPI Backend
info.description:
**LankaLens API Platform**: Precision Cartography & Intelligent Sustainable Tourism API for Sri Lanka.

Provides REST endpoints for exploring destinations, building dynamic multi-day itineraries, interacting with AI assistants, tracking real-time site crowd density, and submitting verified contributions.
